name: Startups.watch

sources.title: Startups.watch — live Turkish startup database (20,000+ startups); Tools > For Startups > 'Add Startup'; claimed profiles; investor/accelerator programs, demo days; free signup

requirements: Turkish ecosystem focus — 'Comprehensive data covering Türkiye and Turkish-founded startups across the globe'
Free signup; Tools menu > For Startups > 'Add Startup'
Claimed Profile(s) feature for existing records
Investor-facing tools (deal flow, programs, demo days) mean profiles should be funding-ready
preparation: Startup details: description, category, founding year, HQ, people, funding data
workflow: Tools > For Startups > 'Add Startup' (or claim an existing profile)
Profile joins the 20k-startup database browsed by investors/accelerators
watchFor: Turkey-only relevance — no fit for startups outside the Turkish ecosystem
Audience is investors/ecosystem actors, not consumers
Investor features are paid/premium-tiered presumably — startup side appears free
countsAsLive: The startup has a public profile in the startups.watch database
